lead_fa: Survival یک اسپک میله‌ای پرسرعت است که هر ثانیه دکمه‌ای برای فشردن دارد: با [[Raptor Strike]] و [[Kill Command]] در کنار پت می‌جنگی و Focus و Tip of the Spear را مدیریت می‌کنی. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Sentinel]] که با تنظیم فعلی انتخاب اول ST و AoE است و [[Pack Leader]] با چرخهٔ سریع Raptor Strike/Kill Command.

strengths: Large survivability from Mastery: Spirit Bond passive DR plus flexible Tenacity/Ferocity pet defensives
Very safe in solo and open-world content
Class-wide unique throughput utility through Hunter's Mark
weaknesses: Poor play runs you out of resources and creates downtime
Loot pool mixes dual-wield and two-handed melee weapons, making specific weapons hard to get
Reliant on the pet for resource generation and damage
Utility kit is more catered to Mythic+ than Raid
Extremely reliant on tuning versus the other Hunter specs

hero.recommendation: Sentinel is the go-to pick in AoE and ST in Midnight Season 2; Pack Leader is close but more impacted by downtime and its Boar can be parried or miss without any control from you.
hero.sentinel: Revolves around managing Sentinel's Mark, which greatly empowers Wildfire Bomb; the pick if you prefer a more normal Survival rotation.
hero.pack_leader: Cycles Raptor Strike and Kill Command to trigger as many Howl of the Pack Leader summons as possible; fast playstyle with resource efficiency focus.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Survival Hunter Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/hunter/survival/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Juggle Focus, Tip of the Spear stacks, and the cooldowns of Wildfire Bomb and Boomstick.
Kill Command refills Tip of the Spear: never let the stacks sit empty.
Wildfire Bomb under Sentinel's Mark or when it is about to recharge (~4-6s left).

st_sentinel: Hunter's Mark if not yet active
Kill Command whenever you run out of Tip of the Spear stacks
Wildfire Bomb if the target is affected by Sentinel's Mark, or if ~4-6 seconds remain until Wildfire Bomb is fully recharged
Kill Command once before entering Takedown to maximize Tip of the Spear stacks
Takedown if you have a Tip of the Spear stack to spend
rotation.takedown_notes: Takedown is an extremely short-duration damage cooldown that should always be buffed with Tip of the Spear; its 20% buff to you and your pet only affects class-specific damaging abilities (no trinkets or outside effects). Usually a 60s CD with 2 points in Savagery.
rotation.opener: Open with Hunter's Mark up and Kill Command into Takedown with full Tip of the Spear stacks; align the on-use trinket with Takedown windows.

gear.gearing_rules: Mastery > Critical Strike >= Haste > Versatility for both heroes. Maximize cantrip effects (Band of the Swarmcaller, Aberrant Commander's Gauntlets); round out stats to the best ratio. Many sets fit within ~0.2% of the best ratio, so keep alternatives from vaults/bonus rolls. One on-use trinket paired with a passive, lined up with Takedown.
gear.weapon_note: Main Hand: Aman'muso, Warlord's Vengeance; Off Hand: Zatha'tek, Breath of Corruption; alternative 2-Hand: Maze-roa, Warlord's Fury.

mplus.hero_note: Sentinel is the go-to pick in M+; Sentinel's Mark empowers Wildfire Bomb for pack damage.
tips: The utility kit shines in keys: Freezing Trap, Tar Trap, Misdirection on the tank every pull.
Keep a pet with appropriate debuffs; Ferocity pets give a defensive Primal Rage alternative.
Boomstick and Wildfire Bomb cover spread packs; save Tip of the Spear for Takedown on big targets.
